title: Make and C or C++ builds
description: Build with make and the compilers of Xcode or the Command Line Tools.
notes: make, cc, clang and the other build tools in /usr/bin are only doors to the tools in Xcode or in the Command Line Tools, so a build with make needs one of the two and nothing else beyond the project and the temporary folders.
Not covered: xcodebuild and swift, which also keep caches and build folders outside the project. Use the Xcode pack for them.

recorded.by: sandbox-discover, with Xcode 27 and with the Command Line Tools alone (DEVELOPER_DIR), then a build under the pack's folders alone
